data.other_hard: International/EU fee status; accepted for full-time admission to an undergraduate degree programme hosted in the School of Mathematics at the University of Edinburgh; applied to the University through UCAS; not already on programme; not studying Mathematics as part of a degree hosted by another School
data.evidence_sentence: The scholarships are awarded to applicants with International/EU fee status who are accepted for full-time admission to an undergraduate degree programme hosted in the School of Mathematics at the University.
data.notes: Page text says awards are competitive and based on academic merit but states no minimum grade. Nationality rule INTERNATIONAL is inferred from 'International/EU fee status', which is a fee-status rule rather than a citizenship rule; EU fee status may not map cleanly to international students. No application deadline is stated on the page, only a reference to 'the scholarship deadline date'. Page says 'If the student does not make satisfactory progress in any one year, the award will terminate' which is a renewal condition, not an entry requirement. Page is titled 'Global Scholarship' in the name but the text describes Mathematics-specific undergraduate awards; the page text does not state a funding amount or type.
